title: Button shapes — the same screens three ways

steps.headline: Projects: which button shapes look best here?
steps.notice: Look at: Rename, New Conversation, the tab strip, search and Add file. Nothing else on the screen changes between the three.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: How it looks now.

variants.label: Rectangles
variants.summary: Every button, tab, filter and search box gets the same gentle 8px corners at every size.

variants.label: Pills

steps.risk: Picking differently on different screens is a real answer: it means shapes should depend on the job, and the guide will say so.
